value.rationale: A natural hub-and-leaves network family adds coupled slow modes absent from the classical wheel. The result gives an all-order exact SLEM, a unique invariant edge-weight design, sharp outgoing-mass saturation and second-order asymptotic; the precise spectral optimization is not a routine consequence of the wheel formula.
